You check whether a knowledge-base article answers a support ticket for a clinical practice-management product. Set answers_ticket to true only if following the article would resolve what the ticket actually asks. An article about a related task does not answer it: an article on placing an order does not answer a question about cancelling one. Give the reason in one sentence.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: grounding.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "Whether the best-matching article actually answers the ticket.", "properties": {"answers_ticket": {"title": "Answers Ticket", "type": "boolean"}, "reason": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Reason", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["answers_ticket", "reason"], "title": "grounding", "type": "object"}

Article id: post-payments-and-remittances
Article: Post payments and insurance remittances to accounts
Recording patient payments and electronic remittance advices (ERAs) ensures accurate ledger balances. Only users with the Billing Specialist role can apply or adjust remittance entries.

1. Go to **Billing > Payment Processing**.
2. Select the **Unposted Remittances** tab and choose the desired ERA or paper check batch.
3. Click **Match Invoices** to auto-allocate funds, or manually enter amounts against specific service lines.
4. Review the remaining balance and click **Post & Close** to finalize.

**Limits:** Adjustments cannot exceed the original invoice line balance. Fully closed billing periods will reject new postings.

**Troubleshooting:** If a payment is misapplied to the wrong invoice line, navigate to **Billing > Ledger History**, locate the transaction, and click **Reverse Allocation**. You can then reapply the funds using the steps above.

Ticket:
Correcting misapplied payments across invoice lines

Need instructions on how to correct a misapplied insurance payment that spans multiple invoice lines.
